verdict.rationale: Railway ships an official CLI for local development and terminal deploys. The docs tie it directly to AI-native workflows: one command installs the CLI, configures skills, MCP and authentication, and the CLI also starts authenticated OpenCode servers on cloud agents. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
Install the Railway CLI and configure agent support — skills, MCP, and authentication — in one command.
This installs or reuses the Railway CLI, installs the `use-railway` skill, configures Railway MCP for detected tools, and checks Railway authentication.
The CLI starts an authenticated OpenCode server on a cloud agent, checks its HTTPS connection, and gives your client everything it needs to connect.
